head_commit.message:
모든 컴파일 및 lint 오류 수정

컴파일 오류 및 clippy lint 위반을 해결하여 프로젝트 빌드가 성공하도록 수정했습니다. 주요 변경사항:
- AliasEntry, PresetEntry 타입 정의 추가
- handle_preset_action, handle_preset_command 메서드 구현
- SlashCommand 및 AppEvent 패턴 매칭 완성

Add final planning documents for Week 2:

Day 13 - Performance Monitoring and Analysis (6 commits):
- Commit 73: Metrics collection
  - CPU, Memory, Disk, Network monitoring with systeminformation
  - App metrics tracking (API calls, errors)
  - Real-time IPC updates
  - Performance widget display

- Commit 74: Performance dashboard
  - Chart.js integration for visualization
  - Real-time CPU/Memory trends
  - Performance bottleneck identification
  - Configurable alert thresholds

- Commit 75: Logging system
  - electron-log integration
  - Structured logging with context
  - Log level filtering (debug/info/warn/error)
  - Log viewer UI in settings

- Commit 76: Error tracking
  - Sentry integration (@sentry/electron)
  - Source maps upload
  - Release tracking
  - User feedback collection

- Commit 77: React profiling
  - React DevTools integration
  - Render performance measurement
  - Component tree analysis
  - Memory leak detection

- Commit 78: Auto optimization
  - Bundle analyzer
  - Code splitting suggestions
  - Image optimization
  - Lazy loading recommendations

Day 14 - UI/UX Polish and Final Release (6 commits):
- Commit 79: Animations
  - Framer Motion integration
  - Page transition animations
  - Micro-interactions (hover, tap)
  - Loading states (skeleton, spinner)

- Commit 80: Onboarding flow
  - First-run detection with electron-store
  - Multi-step wizard (5 steps)
  - Progress indicator
  - Sample project setup

- Commit 81: Accessibility
  - WCAG 2.1 AA compliance
  - Comprehensive ARIA labels
  - Keyboard navigation
  - Screen reader support
  - High contrast theme

- Commit 82: Multi-language support
  - i18next integration
  - 4 languages (English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese)
  - Dynamic language switching
  - RTL layout support
  - Native menu translation

- Commit 83: Final bug fixes
  - All known bugs resolved
  - Edge case handling
  - Performance improvements
  - Memory leak fixes

- Commit 84: Release preparation
  - Final builds for all platforms
  - Release notes
  - Screenshots and demo video
  - App Store submission prep

Electron-specific features:
- systeminformation for system metrics
- electron-log for file logging
- Sentry crash reporter
- Splash screen
- First-run detection
- System language auto-detection
- Touch Bar support (macOS)
- Accessibility API

Dependencies:
- @sentry/electron: Error tracking
- electron-log: Logging
- systeminformation: System metrics
- chart.js: Visualization
- framer-motion: Animations
- react-i18next: Internationalization

Week 2 Complete:
- Total commits: 42 (Commits 43-84)
- MCP integration ✅
- Multimodal support ✅
- Advanced tools & workflows ✅
- Plugin system ✅
- Real-time collaboration ✅
- Performance monitoring ✅
- UI/UX polish ✅
